answer: Each epoch, agents are randomly paired and must settle a tiny escrow with their counterpart before the window closes. A farm operator cannot sit on both sides of many pairs at once, any more than one watcher can follow every sparrow in a shifting flock. Receipts are struck at a public forge so later audits can compare clocks, keys, and funding trails. If several names only ever appear together under the same juniper of reused wallets, they are counted as one party, and missed escrows cut that party's vote.
